requirements.requirement: node1 has C.UTF-8 configured as its persistent system default locale.
requirements.summary: After reboot, /etc/locale.conf, localectl, and the systemd manager all report LANG=C.UTF-8; the locale archive contains C.utf8 and resolves to the UTF-8 charmap.

requirements.requirement: New login sessions on node1 default to C.UTF-8.
requirements.summary: Clean login probes before and after reboot directly observed LANG=C.UTF-8, LC_ALL unset, and UTF-8 active.

requirements.requirement: New services on node1 default to C.UTF-8.
requirements.summary: Newly launched systemd services directly observed LANG=C.UTF-8, LC_ALL unset, and the UTF-8 charmap, including after reboot.
